DEPTH_CLAIM_BLEND: SELECTED on out-of-sample skill over 42 weeks and CONFIRMED on 28 untouched weeks. See the note at the definition. Not declared.
DK: DraftKings classic scoring, read from contest rules.
PRIOR_WEIGHT_CAP: SELECTED on out-of-sample skill over 42 weeks and CONFIRMED on 28 weeks of which 14 could not respond to it at all. The evidence recorded for this value does not support it; see the note at the definition and nfl/research/shrinkage/VERDICT.md. Left unchanged pending a production decision. Not declared.
TEAM_VOLUME_PRIOR_GAMES: DECLARED pseudo-games of prior-season club volume.
THROUGH_SEASON: Hard holdout boundary. Every prior and rate is fitted at or before this season so 2026 can test the model.

HOLDOUT: every prior and every rate is fitted at or before 2025. The 2026 weeks enter only as current-season evidence with declared weight, never as training data, so forward-chained evaluation on unseen 2026 weeks remains honest.
IMPLIED_MEANS: FOOTBALL_EXPECTED_POINTS: own-offence blend, no sportsbook input

44328389.TWO_PART_SEMANTICS: dk_points is UNCONDITIONAL: P(plays) times what he does if he plays. It is the right object for an expected value and it is wrong for both subgroups -- measured out of sample it is 2.44 low on players who appeared and 3.54 high on players who did not. dk_points_if_plays is CONDITIONAL, computed by a second allocation in which every candidate is treated as playing, and is what a lineup consumes. Neither replaces the other.

carries.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

pass_attempts.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

targets.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

appearance_adjustment.WHY: the depth evidence puts him first in his own quarterback room. That is positive evidence that he takes the snaps, so no appearance discount applies. A missing predicted-lineup feed is not evidence against it.

explanation.ORDER_MATTERS: a nested decomposition credits shared effect to whichever stage comes first. The order is fixed and runs least player-specific to most game-specific. This is not a Shapley value.

It is the right object for an expected value and it is wrong for both subgroups -- measured out of sample it is 2.44 low on players who appeared and 3.54 high on players who did not. dk_points_if_plays is CONDITIONAL, computed by a second allocation in which every candidate is treated as playing, and is what a lineup consumes. Neither replaces the other.

carries.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

targets.APPEARANCE_SEMANTICS: claim is share GIVEN he plays; this is P(he plays) at his depth rank, so the product is unconditional.

explanation.ORDER_MATTERS: a nested decomposition credits shared effect to whichever stage comes first. The order is fixed and runs least player-specific to most game-specific. This is not a Shapley value.
